Global Market: South Korean stocks surge nearly 3% as AI chip optimism lifts Samsung, SK Hynix
description: South Korean shares surged nearly 3% on Monday, led by Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, as optimism over sustained AI investment and strong semiconductor demand lifted investor sentiment. Strong exports and a firmer won also supported the broader market, with foreign investors turning net buyers of South Korean equities.

title: AI in pharma moves from lab development to patient impact
description: AI cuts the hit-to-lead drug development phase from years to months. IT teams must now build GxP-compliant MLOps pipelines and secure architectures for clinical and genomic data.
